answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 21305 Country: Pakistan Title: what ulama says about ;delivering a speech after the first AZAN for JUMA prayer. Is it innovation Is there any proof Quran and Hadith? Question: what ulama says about ;delivering a speech after the first AZAN for JUMA prayer. Is it innovation Is there any proof Quran and Hadith? Answer ID: 21305 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 480/480/M=1431) If people are not offering sunnah at that time, there is no problem in delivering speech, but usually at this time people are engaged in offering sunnah and they are disturbed by speech; hence it is better if speech is in last time after completing salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
